# Habibur Rahman — Full-Stack Developer Portfolio

> Product-driven full-stack developer based in Dhaka, Bangladesh.
> Specializing in Next.js, React, and TypeScript.
> Building scalable web applications, SaaS platforms, and e-commerce solutions for international clients.

## About

Habibur Rahman is a full-stack developer and the Founder & CEO of BioFidelicX
(https://biofidex.com), an educational platform focused on bioscience education.
He transitioned from Biochemistry & Molecular Biology (BSc, Jagannath University)
to software development, bringing analytical precision to frontend engineering and
user experience design.

He works with international clients via Upwork and direct engagements, delivering
production-ready web applications trusted in real-world environments.

## Services

- **Website Design & Development** — Modern, fast, responsive websites for businesses,
  landing pages, and portfolios. SEO-ready layouts and performance-focused frontend.
- **Web App & Dashboard Development** — SaaS tools, admin panels, dashboards, and full-stack
  applications using Next.js and React.
- **UI/UX Improvement & Optimization** — UI redesigns, accessibility fixes, mobile responsiveness,
  frontend refactoring, and performance optimization for existing products.

## Tech Stack

- **Frontend**: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, Framer Motion, Shadcn/ui, Radix UI
- **State**: Redux Toolkit, Zustand, React Query, Context API
- **Backend & Database**: Supabase, Firebase, PostgreSQL, Prisma ORM, REST APIs
- **Auth & Payments**: Stripe, NextAuth.js, Supabase Auth, OAuth
- **Deployment**: Vercel, Cloudflare, GitHub Actions

## Featured Projects

- [BioFidelicX](https://biofidex.com) — Bioscience education platform with quizzes, articles,
  and courses. Built with Next.js, TypeScript, and Supabase. Founded 2019.
- [Al-Bayt Elegance](https://www.thealbayt.com) — E-commerce platform for Islamic fashion
  with secure payments and real-time inventory. Built with React, Firebase, and Stripe.
- [Noor Jabal Cleaning](https://noorjabalcleaning.com/) — Professional service website for a
  Dubai-based cleaning company. Built with Next.js.
